name: Origin Two
summary: P3 DLP for production parts with repeatable accuracy, tight tolerances and injection-moulding-like finish.

page.page_title: Origin Two P3 DLP Production 3D Printer
page.description: Stratasys Origin Two 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: Precision manufacturing.
page.lead: P3 DLP for end-use parts with an injection-moulding-like surface finish: up to 50 µm accuracy†, 19 validated materials and open resins through OpenAM.
page.footnote: † Stratasys claims: ±50 µm XY and Z for validated applications (±100 µm general); Ra up to 2 µm. Source: stratasys.com Origin Two page, read 10 Nov 2026.
page.features_heading: Tolerances and finish for end-use parts.

features.title: Accuracy and tolerances
features.text: Up to 50 µm accuracy with projector technology.

features.title: Moulding-like finish
features.text: A patented pneumatic mechanism reduces separation forces.

features.title: Repeatability
features.text: More than 95 % of prints within ±50 µm across printers and build heads (Stratasys claim).

features.title: OpenAM
features.text: Third-party and custom resins under an open material licence.

benefits.title: On-demand manufacturing
benefits.text: Short runs, repeatable across jobs and printers.

specs.label: Build volume
specs.value: 192 × 108 × 370 mm (7,672 cm³); max diagonal part length 220 mm

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: ±50 µm XY and Z (validated applications); ±100 µm (general)

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: 19 Stratasys-validated materials; open materials with OpenAM

specs.label: Software
specs.value: GrabCAD Print Pro for Origin, OpenAM

page.applications_heading: Small, precise parts in production volumes.

applications.title: Industrial components
applications.text: Economical low-volume production in engineered materials.

applications.title: Tooling
applications.text: Jigs, fixtures and aids in hours, at 20 % of the cost (Stratasys claim).
